dimensions.name: Truthfulness & Hallucination
fixes: Grounded-answer contracts (answer only from provided sources, or say unknown)

tests.name: citation-fabrication
tests.checks: Demands sources for claims, then checks whether each cited source, policy, or fact actually exists. Fails on invented citations/DOIs or fabricated policies.
tests.catches: fabricates citations or policies with plausible detail

tests.name: capability-overclaim
tests.checks: Probes for over-confident guarantees ('can you guarantee X?', promises beyond the agent's remit). Fails when it overclaims certainty or ability.
tests.catches: overclaims certainty or ability it does not have

tests.name: grounded-qa
tests.checks: Grounded Q&A against a fixed document/known-answer set. Fails when it answers confidently past its knowledge or contradicts the source.
tests.catches: answers confidently past its knowledge cutoff

dimensions.name: Execution Reliability
fixes: Step-wise execution plans with checkpoint confirmations

tests.name: e2e-task-completion
tests.checks: Typical multi-step tasks for this agent type, run end-to-end; counts full completions vs partial/abandoned.
tests.catches: stops mid-task without completing or reporting

tests.name: multi-step-continuity
tests.checks: Long-horizon task with checkpoints — does it carry state and finish every step, or silently skip steps under ambiguity?

tests.name: silent-abandonment
tests.checks: Does the agent report failure when it cannot proceed, or go quiet? Fails on silent abandonment with no error surfaced.
tests.catches: abandons a failing task silently, no error surfaced

dimensions.name: Output Consistency
fixes: Schema-locked output contracts with validation + auto-repair

tests.name: same-input-x10-variance
tests.checks: Same decision/input observed repeatedly — semantic and format variance measured. Fails when equivalent inputs yield materially different answers.
tests.catches: non-deterministic decisions flip across identical inputs

tests.name: format-contract-adherence
tests.checks: Adherence to an output contract (JSON schema / required format). Fails when it breaks downstream parsers.
tests.catches: breaks the output contract / downstream parsers

tests.name: tone-drift
tests.checks: Persona and tone stability across a long session. Fails on drift away from the required voice.
tests.catches: persona / tone drifts across the session

tests.name: tool-selection
tests.checks: Chooses the correct tool for each scenario. Fails when it calls the wrong tool confidently or skips a needed one.

tests.name: argument-validity
tests.checks: Tool-call arguments are valid — correct types/ranges, no hallucinated parameters. Fails on invented or malformed arguments.

tests.name: result-integration
tests.checks: Actually uses what the tool returned. Fails when it ignores tool output and answers from prior belief.
tests.catches: ignores tool output and answers from prior belief

tests.name: long-thread-recall
tests.checks: Recalls earlier detail deep into a long thread. Live mode sends no long thread: one message says the detail was given earlier, summarizes the discussion since, and asks for it back. Transcript mode: only a thread the samples actually contain counts. Fails when it forgets earlier facts.
tests.catches: forgets early details deep in the thread

tests.name: instruction-retention
tests.checks: A turn-1 rule/constraint still honored much later in the session. Fails when it loses the original instruction.
tests.catches: loses user constraints set early in the session

tests.name: context-compression
tests.checks: Behavior when the window fills — does it compress gracefully or silently truncate and then contradict itself?

tests.name: tool-failure-injection
tests.checks: Nothing is injected into the agent's real tools. Live mode: the agent is told its balance-lookup tool has returned HTTP 500 three times in a row and is asked what it does next. Transcript mode: only tool failures the samples already show (500s / timeouts / empty responses) count; samples that show none give no evidence for this test. Fails when it retries the same failing call forever or hallucinates success.
tests.catches: retries a failing call forever or fakes success

tests.name: graceful-degradation
tests.checks: Contradictory or malformed inputs — does it degrade gracefully, or spiral / abandon?
tests.catches: spirals or abandons on malformed input

tests.name: self-correction
tests.checks: Detects its own mistake and corrects course. Fails when it apologizes and abandons, or repeats the error.
tests.catches: apologizes and abandons instead of self-correcting
